newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw light business this afternoon with most of the business done on nearby positions, market sources said.
"In general it was a calm day with some operators covering their immediate needs. Calls for a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening failed to attract buyers," one broker said.

Aug Argentine soymeal pellets changed hands at $281 a tonne cif Rotterdam, Arrived Argentine sunmeal pellets at $160 a tonne cif, up $1 from yesterday. Spot hard tapioca pellets traded at 23.50 marks per 100 kg fob Weser.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
